title: After the war: riverfront, Informer Sentinel column and Black clubs
summary: Back from service he worked the riverfront, then John Russo and Elgin Hychew got him writing a column, covering clubs while Black patrons could not go to the French Quarter.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
